title: Light Mist
alt: Four panels. Panel 1: In the teal office at night, a small grey raincloud wearing a teal tie floats in front of Margo's desk. It holds a clipboard and drizzles lightly onto a puddle on the floor. Margo, the tall caseworker in round glasses and a mustard cardigan, looks at it deadpan from behind her desk. Pip, the small lavender candle-wisp, has both arms up at their little desk and stares at the rain in delight. Panel 2: Closer on the cloud, Fen, who tugs at their tie with a nervous, flustered face. A sweat drop shows and the rain is heavier. Pip looks up at them, working it out. Panel 3: Seen from the other side of the office. Pip, smiling, brings their stamp down on a request slip at their desk. Fen hovers in the middle, tugging their tie and dripping into a small puddle. Margo writes at her desk on the right without looking up. Panel 4: In the stairwell, the fire door beside a big painted 5 stands open. Warm, late-afternoon light shows through the gap, and a rust-coloured rubber doorstop is wedged under the door. Fen floats by the door, dry now, smiling and looking back. Pip waves from the top of the stairs.
hover: Fen has since filed a stairwell audit. Recommendation: more doorstops.
transcript: Panel 1 – FEN: Hi. Fen, Medium. Quick ask. Super small.
Panel 2 – FEN: I'm auditing the stairwell door. The one that shuts behind you.
Panel 2 – FEN: Locked in. To the outside.
Panel 4 – FEN: Great outcome. Let's circle back.
note: Our first visitor. Fen is from upstairs, where they do outcomes, not luck. Still, a doorstop is a doorstop.
